---- MODULE ivy_examples_ticket ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_ticketDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL TkNI == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction

TkTypeOK ==
  /\ pc \in [Thread -> {"Idle", "Waiting", "Critical"}]
  /\ service \in Nat
  /\ next_ticket \in Nat
  /\ m \in [Thread -> Nat]

TkInv ==
  /\ TkTypeOK
  /\ service <= next_ticket
  /\ \A u \in Thread : pc[u] # "Idle" => (service <= m[u] /\ m[u] < next_ticket)
  /\ \A u1, u2 \in Thread :
        (pc[u1] # "Idle" /\ pc[u2] # "Idle" /\ m[u1] = m[u2]) => u1 = u2
  /\ \A u \in Thread : pc[u] = "Critical" => m[u] = service
  /\ \A j \in Nat : (service <= j /\ j < next_ticket)
                       => (\E u \in Thread : pc[u] # "Idle" /\ m[u] = j)

TkStp(u) ==
  \/ TakeTicket(u)
  \/ \E k \in Nat : EnterCritical(u, k)
  \/ LeaveCritical(u)

TkWt(u, k) == pc[u] = "Waiting" /\ m[u] = k /\ service = k
TkCr(u, k) == pc[u] = "Critical" /\ m[u] = k /\ service = k
TkWq(u, c) == pc[u] = "Waiting" /\ m[u] = c
TkAt(u, j, n) == pc[u] = "Waiting" /\ service = j /\ m[u] = j + n

TkHyp(u) == []TkInv /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Step(u))
TkLive == []TkInv /\ [][Next]_vars /\ (\A u \in Thread : WF_vars(Step(u)))

TkFW2C(u, k) == TkWt(u, k) ~> TkCr(u, k)
TkFC2S(u, k) == TkCr(u, k) ~> (service = k + 1)
TkFHold(u, k) == (pc[u] # "Idle" /\ m[u] = k /\ service = k) ~> (service = k + 1)
TkFAdv(k) == (service = k /\ k < next_ticket) ~> (service = k + 1)
TkEvS(k) == <>(service = k + 1)
TkFEv(t, j, n) == TkAt(t, j, n) ~> (pc[t] = "Critical")
TkFGoal(t) == (pc[t] = "Waiting") ~> (pc[t] = "Critical")
TkKey(t) == TkLive /\ pc[t] = "Waiting" => <>(pc[t] = "Critical")
TkReachP(t, n) == TkLive => (\A j \in Nat : TkFEv(t, j, n))

(***************************************************************************)
(* The inductive invariant.                                                *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TkInitInv == Init => TkInv
  BY SMTT("r10") DEF Init, TkInv, TkTypeOK

LEMMA TkNextInv == TkInv /\ [Next]_vars => TkInv'
  BY SMTT("r30")
     DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

LEMMA TkInvMutex == TkInv => MutualExclusion
  BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, MutualExclusion

LEMMA TkSafeBox == SafetySpec => []TkInv
  BY TkInitInv, TkNextInv, PTL DEF SafetySpec

(***************************************************************************)
(* Enabledness of Step(u).                                                 *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TkEnStepC ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, TkTypeOK, pc[u] = "Critical"
  PROVE  ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
  <1>1. ENABLED <<LeaveCritical(u)>>_vars
    BY ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r10") DEF LeaveCritical, vars, TkTypeOK
  <1>2. ENABLED <<TkStp(u)>>_vars
    BY <1>1, ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r10")
       DEF TkStp, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars
  <1>3. QED BY <1>2, Zenon DEF TkStp, Step

LEMMA TkEnStepW ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, TkTypeOK, pc[u] = "Waiting", m[u] <= service
  PROVE  ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
  <1>1. ENABLED <<EnterCritical(u, m[u])>>_vars
    BY ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r10") DEF EnterCritical, vars, TkTypeOK
  <1>2. ENABLED <<TkStp(u)>>_vars
    BY <1>1, ExpandENABLED, SMTT("r10")
       DEF TkStp, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars
  <1>3. QED BY <1>2, Zenon DEF TkStp, Step

(***************************************************************************)
(* State-level and action-level facts.                                     *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TkClass ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat,
         TkInv, pc[u] # "Idle", m[u] = k, service = k
  PROVE  TkWt(u, k) \/ TkCr(u, k)
  BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkWt, TkCr

LEMMA TkHolder ==
  ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, TkInv, service = k, k < next_ticket
  PROVE  \E u \in Thread : pc[u] # "Idle" /\ m[u] = k
  BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK

LEMMA TkSplit ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, TkInv, pc[t] = "Waiting"
  PROVE  \E j \in Nat, n \in Nat : TkAt(t, j, n)
  <1>1. service \in Nat /\ m[t] \in Nat /\ service <= m[t]
    BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK
  <1>2. (m[t] - service) \in Nat /\ m[t] = service + (m[t] - service)
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r10")
  <1>3. TkAt(t, service, m[t] - service)
    BY <1>2, Zenon DEF TkAt
  <1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, Zenon

LEMMA TkWqStb ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW c, TkInv
  PROVE  TkWq(t, c) /\ [Next]_vars => (TkWq(t, c)' \/ (pc[t] = "Critical")')
  BY SMTT("r30")
     DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkWq, Next, Step,
         TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

(***************************************************************************)
(* The two WF1 steps: a waiting thread whose ticket is being served enters *)
(* the critical section, and a critical thread leaves it, bumping service. *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TkW2C ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  TkHyp(u) => TkFW2C(u, k)
  <1>1. TkInv /\ TkWt(u, k) /\ [Next]_vars => (TkWt(u, k)' \/ TkCr(u, k)')
    BY SMTT("r30")
       DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkWt, TkCr, Next, Step,
           TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars
  <1>2. TkInv /\ TkWt(u, k) /\ <<Step(u)>>_vars => TkCr(u, k)'
    BY SMTT("r30")
       DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkWt, TkCr, Step,
           TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars
  <1>3. TkInv /\ TkWt(u, k) => ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
    BY TkEnStepW, SMTT("r10") DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkWt
  <1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TkHyp, TkFW2C

LEMMA TkC2S ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  TkHyp(u) => TkFC2S(u, k)
  <1>1. TkInv /\ TkCr(u, k) /\ [Next]_vars => (TkCr(u, k)' \/ (service = k + 1)')
    BY SMTT("r30")
       DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkCr, Next, Step,
           TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars
  <1>2. TkInv /\ TkCr(u, k) /\ <<Step(u)>>_vars => (service = k + 1)'
    BY SMTT("r30")
       DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkCr, Step,
           TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars
  <1>3. TkInv /\ TkCr(u, k) => ENABLED <<Step(u)>>_vars
    BY TkEnStepC, SMTT("r10") DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkCr
  <1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TkHyp, TkFC2S

LEMMA TkHold ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  TkHyp(u) => TkFHold(u, k)
  <1>1. TkInv /\ pc[u] # "Idle" /\ m[u] = k /\ service = k
          => (TkWt(u, k) \/ TkCr(u, k))
    BY TkClass, SMTT("r10")
  <1>2. TkHyp(u) => TkFW2C(u, k)
    BY TkW2C, SMTT("r10")
  <1>3. TkHyp(u) => TkFC2S(u, k)
    BY TkC2S, SMTT("r10")
  <1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TkHyp, TkFW2C, TkFC2S, TkFHold

(***************************************************************************)
(* The liveness hypotheses are stable.                                     *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TkFairBox ==
  (\A u \in Thread : WF_vars(Step(u))) => [](\A u \in Thread : WF_vars(Step(u)))
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME \A u \in Thread : WF_vars(Step(u))
               PROVE  [](\A u \in Thread : WF_vars(Step(u)))
    BY Isa
  <1>1. \A u \in Thread : []WF_vars(Step(u))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW u \in Thread PROVE []WF_vars(Step(u))
      BY Zenon
    <2>1. WF_vars(Step(u))
      BY Isa
    <2>2. QED BY <2>1, PTL
  <1>2. QED BY <1>1, Zenon

LEMMA TkLiveStable == TkLive => []TkLive
  BY TkFairBox, PTL DEF TkLive

LEMMA TkLiveHyp ==
  ASSUME NEW u \in Thread
  PROVE  TkLive => TkHyp(u)
  BY Isa DEF TkLive, TkHyp

(***************************************************************************)
(* service keeps advancing as long as some ticket is outstanding.          *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TkAdv ==
  ASSUME NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  TkLive /\ service = k /\ k < next_ticket => TkEvS(k)
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME TkLive, service = k, k < next_ticket
               PROVE  TkEvS(k)
    BY Isa DEF TkEvS
  <1>1. TkInv
    BY PTL DEF TkLive
  <1>2. PICK u \in Thread : pc[u] # "Idle" /\ m[u] = k
    BY <1>1, TkHolder, Isa
  <1>3. TkHyp(u)
    BY <1>2, TkLiveHyp, Isa
  <1>4. TkFHold(u, k)
    BY <1>2, <1>3, TkHold, Isa
  <1>5. QED BY <1>2, <1>4, PTL DEF TkFHold, TkEvS

LEMMA TkAdvLT ==
  ASSUME NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  TkLive => TkFAdv(k)
  <1>1. TkLive /\ service = k /\ k < next_ticket => TkEvS(k)
    BY TkAdv, SMTT("r10")
  <1>2. TkLive => []TkLive
    BY TkLiveStable, SMTT("r10")
  <1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF TkFAdv, TkEvS

(***************************************************************************)
(* By induction on the distance between the thread's ticket and service,   *)
(* a waiting thread eventually reaches the critical section.               *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA TkReachLem ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW n \in Nat
  PROVE  TkReachP(t, n)
  <1> DEFINE Prop(i) == TkReachP(t, i)
  <1>1. Prop(0)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in Nat
                 PROVE  TkLive => TkFEv(t, j, 0)
      BY Isa DEF Prop, TkReachP
    <2>1. TkLive => TkHyp(t)
      BY TkLiveHyp, SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. TkHyp(t) => TkFW2C(t, j)
      BY TkW2C, SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. TkAt(t, j, 0) => TkWt(t, j)
      BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkAt, TkWt
    <2>4. TkCr(t, j) => (pc[t] = "Critical")
      BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkCr
    <2>5. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, PTL DEF TkFW2C, TkFEv
  <1>2. \A i \in Nat : Prop(i) => Prop(i + 1)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in Nat, NEW j \in Nat
                 PROVE  Prop(i) /\ TkLive => TkFEv(t, j, i + 1)
      BY Isa DEF Prop, TkReachP
    <2>0. j + 1 \in Nat
      BY SMTT("r10")
    <2>1. Prop(i) /\ TkLive => TkFEv(t, j + 1, i)
      BY <2>0, Isa DEF Prop, TkReachP
    <2>2. TkLive => TkFAdv(j)
      BY TkAdvLT, SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. TkInv /\ TkWq(t, j + i + 1) /\ [Next]_vars
            => (TkWq(t, j + i + 1)' \/ (pc[t] = "Critical")')
      BY TkWqStb, SMTT("r10")
    <2>4. TkInv /\ TkAt(t, j, i + 1) => j < next_ticket
      BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkInv, TkTypeOK, TkAt
    <2>5. TkAt(t, j, i + 1) => (TkWq(t, j + i + 1) /\ service = j)
      BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkAt, TkWq
    <2>6. TkWq(t, j + i + 1) /\ service = j + 1 => TkAt(t, j + 1, i)
      BY SMTT("r10") DEF TkAt, TkWq
    <2>7. TkLive => ([]TkInv /\ [][Next]_vars)
      BY Isa DEF TkLive
    <2>8. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, PTL
             DEF TkFEv, TkFAdv
  <1>3. \A i \in Nat : Prop(i)
    BY <1>1, <1>2, TkNI!NatInduction
  <1>4. QED BY <1>3, SMTT("r10")

LEMMA TkKeyInit ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread
  PROVE  TkKey(t)
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME TkLive, pc[t] = "Waiting"
               PROVE  <>(pc[t] = "Critical")
    BY Isa DEF TkKey
  <1>1. TkInv
    BY PTL DEF TkLive
  <1>2. PICK j \in Nat, n \in Nat : TkAt(t, j, n)
    BY <1>1, TkSplit, Isa
  <1>3. TkLive => TkFEv(t, j, n)
    BY TkReachLem, Isa DEF TkReachP
  <1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF TkFEv

LEMMA TkGoalLem ==
  ASSUME NEW t \in Thread
  PROVE  TkLive => TkFGoal(t)
  <1>1. TkKey(t)
    BY TkKeyInit, SMTT("r10")
  <1>2. TkLive => []TkLive
    BY TkLiveStable, SMTT("r10")
  <1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF TkKey, TkFGoal

LEMMA TkSpecLive == Spec => TkLive
  <1>1. Spec => SafetySpec
    BY Isa DEF Spec
  <1>2. SafetySpec => []TkInv
    BY TkSafeBox, SMTT("r10")
  <1>3. Spec => [][Next]_vars
    BY Isa DEF Spec, SafetySpec
  <1>4. Spec => (\A u \in Thread : WF_vars(Step(u)))
    BY Isa DEF Spec
  <1>5. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, Isa DEF TkLive
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Safety == SafetySpec => []MutualExclusion
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Safety.tla
PROOF
BY TkSafeBox, TkInvMutex, PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Safety.tla

THEOREM Liveness == Spec => NonStarvation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Liveness.tla
PROOF
<1>1. ASSUME NEW t \in Thread
      PROVE  Spec => TkFGoal(t)
  <2>1. Spec => TkLive
    BY TkSpecLive, SMTT("r10")
  <2>2. TkLive => TkFGoal(t)
    BY TkGoalLem, SMTT("r10")
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, Isa
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, Isa DEF NonStarvation, TkFGoal
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Liveness.tla
====
